id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

data.description: Holds the data to display in the diagram viewer.

addOnDataSpec.description:
The specification used to retrieve addOns to be displayed.

An addOn is something that will be placed on top of the diagram. They come in 3 varieties: boxes/rectangles, dots, and text.
Each can have a tooltip as well as hover/click interactions.

startX.description:
The x coordinate for the top left of what should show in the initial state of the diagram
Likely to be used when focused on a specific addOn

extraErrorMessage.description: Message to be displayed if there is an issue loading a file.

startY.description:
The y coordinate for the top left of what should show in the initial state of the diagram
Likely to be used when focused on a specific addOn

emphasizedAddonId.description: The id of an addOn to be the only addOn showing.

hiddenSeries.description: The list of ids/groups of addOns to hide

width.description: Width of the diagram in percentage. Not putting a width will default to 100% width.

height.description: Height of the diagram in pixels.

tooltipInteraction.description: The interaction event that triggers a tooltip on an addOn

focusedAddOnId.description: Id of the addOn to focus on when the diagram loads in, setting the diagram to show this addOn in the center.

legend.description: Whether or not to show a legend

legendStrategy.description:
The criteria for grouping addOns on the legend.
'color' will group addOns based on color.
'shape' will group addOns based on shape (box, text, dot).
'colorAndShape' will group addOns based on both color and shape (ex. 'dot-blue').
'all' will group addOns based on their id.

emptyState.description: The component id to be displayed when the diagram is empty.
